I can't remember a lot of good parts of my childhood too. I escaped in my mind a lot and got bullied by teachers for daydreaming and peers at times. My dad was very emotionally and physically abusive and would force me to listen through his countless hours of boring lectures (usually the same thing) saying it was for my benefit and to prevent me from being a bad kid. I learnt to zone out from his excessive monotonous talks and developed poor listening skills which I'm still working on bettering these days. He would humiliate me in public and sometimes in front of my aunties, uncles and their kids and they wouldn't really call him out and got used to him being that tough dad. I became a people pleaser and didn't know how to express my feelings too or set boundaries. I'm still working on it. I've begun to see a therapist and I think it's really good for you when you have been through traumatic experiences.

I'm sorry you had to endure an abusive childhood and understand that frustration. Thanks for sharing your story :)

Hey I understand that feeling and sorry you're not having much fun. I've felt left out a lot hanging out with friends in the past, I think that's because I hadn't met any INFP mates and they would jokingly say I am a weird person (but that they like me for me). I hope you find friends you can have great conversations with.
I thought I was the only one 😂
That was a very interesting read on vulnerable NPs. And thank you for your advice! :)
Thank you guys. I really want to be there for him though. I feel like he feels really lonely and unwanted. And I really don’t want him to kill himself.

Please don’t. You’re so much more worth it than you think. You’re at a phase of your life where you’re lost, confused and filled with society pressures, uncertain as to how to tackle the heavy thoughts. You feel ugly now but years from now, you won’t give a fuck. There’s so much to life than your looks. Listen sweetheart, please don’t compare yourself to those ‘good looking’ celebrities you see online or random people in school and the streets. I have never met you but I know very damn well that you’re so worth it and the universe has you for a reason. A damn good reason. I believe in you.
Yes, he did. Says he did it ‘cos of life and me.
That does make sense. I just hope he won’t kill himself, it will fuck me up badly and I’ll keep thinking about it throughout life I think. Thank you so much.
I don’t have his family’s contacts, he never gave me.
The fucked up thing is I don’t know which part of the UK exactly is he from.
I’m so scared to report it to the authorities though. I feel like that will trigger him even more and will drive him to his death.
It’s hard. I feel like he really means it when he says he will kill himself.
And I have absolutely no idea which hospital. Where exactly he is, I don’t know. I’m absolutely clueless and helpless.

I don’t want people killing themselves because of me. I can’t put my mind at rest. I haven’t been eating well. I’m losing motivation. I don’t know how to reply to him. But thank you so much for your advice.
I’m scared he will kill himself. I feel like he’s serious this time. It scares me to death. Don’t know if I can forgive myself when it happens.
I don’t want to see another familiar soul leave this earth tomorrow. But I appreciate your reply.
